what_happened.line: The Municipal Building Design Committee heard the building commissioner on how building and energy codes would apply to the hybrid concept for the TCP, Town Hall, Ritter, Brooks house and a possible annex.

The commissioner was asked about the thresholds and phasing that would trigger code upgrades; the earlier full-renovation concept touched more than half the building and triggered a large upgrade package.
The commissioner is to look up the IEBC alteration-level thresholds, phasing and timing and follow up with the committee.
The committee also discussed change of use, site plan and parking questions for Town Hall, Ritter, the Brooks house and a possible Ritter annex.
No votes were taken except adjournment; the chair is to email members to schedule the next meeting. No members of the public were present.

why_it_matters: Whether a renovation touches enough of a building to trigger code upgrades is a mechanism that changes project scope, so it bears on the cost of any building proposal that residents may later be asked to fund.
No decision was made at this meeting; the thresholds the commissioner is still to confirm will shape which concept is workable.
